_about: Copy this file to studio.json and change the paths. studio.json stays on your Mac (it's in .gitignore). Paths may start with ~.
_owner: Your first name. Guides say 'ask <owner>' and the Studio page greets you. Leave empty to be called 'you'.
_content_root: Where your shoots live: one folder per shoot, named by the first day filmed, e.g. '2026-03-14 Kitchen Remodel'. A synced drive folder works (Google Drive, Dropbox), but keep it out of iCloud-synced Documents.
_default_brand: The folder name in brands/ used when a video doesn't say which brand it's for.
_music_library: Licensed music tracks you've picked. Each video gets its own track.
_asset_roots: Folders the Asset Library catalogs: photos, logos, menus, print pieces. Empty = no Asset Library yet (assets/README.md).
_asset_library_dir: Where the Asset Library keeps its catalog and move log.
_asset_never_move: Folders inside your asset roots that the Asset Library must never move or rename (shared with someone else, for example).
_asset_exclude: Folders inside your asset roots to leave out of the catalog.
_asset_cache_dir: Where previews are cached. Empty = <asset_library_dir>/cache.nosync (the .nosync name keeps iCloud away).

voice._about: Your VoiceStudio voice clone (setup/VOICE-STUDIO.md). profile_id comes from VoiceStudio; leave empty until you've made one. engine: keep voxcpm2 (free for commercial use). seed: a take's seed to repeat its delivery, or null.

walkthrough._about: Product walkthrough videos (walkthrough/README.md, 'Settings'). base_url must be your app on localhost or a test host listed in test_hosts, never production. The default points at the bundled demo app.

_work_dir: Where the builders keep their work folders (renders in progress, build records, caches). Empty = inside each style's folder in the kit (kept out of git). Point it somewhere roomy if the kit's drive is small.
_timezone: Your time zone, e.g. "America/Chicago", for dates on log cards. Empty = this Mac's.
_whisper: The transcription model and language. base.en is fast and good for English; a bigger or multilingual model works too (setup/INSTALL.md, step 4).
_people: First names of people who often appear (you, a partner, staff who agreed). Log cards and footage search use them. Only people who are OK being named.
